name: AllocationSlider
summary: Shares a whole (a budget, a week, a weighting) between parts that always add up to the total: the filled bar is what is adjusted. Dragging the boundary between two parts trades share between those two only; typing a share takes from the next unlocked part and says which. Inner segments are square, only the bar's outer ends are rounded. Not for independent values on one scale (use Slider with several thumbs) or for showing shares without changing them (use StackedBar).
a11y: A `group` named by the label. Each boundary is a `slider` whose value is its running total, with dependent min and max, and `aria-valuetext` naming both neighbours ("Design 40 %, Engineering 35 %"). The legend writes every share as text, so the category colours are never the only carrier.

keys.action: move a boundary one step; Page Up / Page Down or Shift + arrows: ten steps; Home / End: as far as the neighbours allow. Right and left swap in right-to-left text.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being shared out, e.g. "Budget". Shown above the bar; names the group.

props.name: segments
props.description: The parts in order; their shares should add up to `total`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new segments while a boundary moves or a share is typed.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Called once on release, key-up or a typed share, with the final segments: save here.

props.name: total
props.description: The whole the shares add up to.

props.name: step
props.description: The smallest change a boundary or typed share makes.

props.name: minShare
props.description: The least any part may hold; 0 lets a part be emptied.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: Page Up / Page Down and Shift + arrows move a boundary by this many steps.

props.name: format
props.description: Says a share the way a person reads it; "40 %" by default.

props.name: input
props.description: A NumberField per part in the legend, to type an exact share.

props.name: size
props.description: The bar's thickness: s 24, normal 32 or l 40 px. Boundaries keep a 24 px hit area at every size.

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the bar that helps share it out.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong and how to fix it. Shares that don't add up to the total say so on their own.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shares are shown and boundaries focusable but nothing changes.

props.name: label
props.description: What the part is, e.g. "Design". Read with its share.

props.name: locked
props.description: The share is fixed: neither boundary beside it moves, and typing never takes from it.

props.name: category
props.description: Its category colour, 1-8 (`color.category.*`). Default: its position, so pass it when parts can be reordered or filtered and each must keep its colour.
